title: What Scripture Actually Means by "Judge Yourself, Not Your Brother"
caption:
Matthew 7 gets quoted like a permission slip to stay out of everyone's business. That's not what it says.

It's an order of operations. Pull the plank out of your own eye first. Then the measure you use on him gets used on you (Matthew 7:2), so most guys have run that backwards for years: generous with themselves, exacting with everyone else.

There's a difference between conviction and condemnation too. The Spirit convicts to move you somewhere. Shame just wants you stuck. Feeling bad about it and getting honest about it aren't the same thing.

Comparing yourself to him tells you nothing true. Confessing to God tells you everything you need.

#faith #scripture #godlyman #christianmen #humility
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
